# LAMMPS input script for Mg melting simulation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
read_data Mg.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Replicate the system
replicate 5 5 5

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300 12345 dist gaussian

# NVT equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
timestep 0.001
thermo 1000
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NPT heating
fix 3 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0

# Calculate density during heating
compute density all property/atom mass
compute vol all reduce sum v_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal c_vol/v_volume

thermo 1000

run 20000

print "Final_density: ${density}"
